# Discord for AI Agents

> Natural-language Discord server administration for AI coding agents. 64 Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools that let Claude Code (and any MCP-compatible agent) build, configure, and operate a Discord community by chat — channels, roles, embeds, AutoMod, welcome screens, scheduled events, threads, webhooks, and full server templates. No menus, no clicking.

## What this is

A one-command plugin for Claude Code that installs a Discord MCP server, two skills (`/discord`, `/discord:setup`), and a Discord-architect sub-agent. Point Claude at a Discord bot token and talk in plain English: "make me a Magic: The Gathering trading server with mod roles and an invite-link filter." It designs, dry-runs, and applies.

## Who it's for

- AI coding agents that need to administer Discord servers programmatically
- Developers launching products (e.g. on Product Hunt) and building a community in minutes
- Open-source maintainers who want infra-as-prompt rather than infra-as-click
- Agent builders exploring Model Context Protocol in production

## Quick start (3 steps, under 2 minutes)

1. Install plugin — inside Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add JCodesMore/jcodesmore-plugins` then `/plugin install discord@jcodesmore-plugins`. Restart Claude Code.
2. Run `/discord:setup` and paste a bot token when asked. The wizard verifies and locks in an active guild.
3. Type `/discord` and talk. Everything else is one chat message away.

## Key capabilities

- 64 Discord tools: channels, categories, roles, permissions, messages, embeds, polls, AutoMod, onboarding, welcome screens, scheduled events, members, webhooks, threads (create, archive, lock, pin, member mgmt), guild config, raw REST escape hatch.
- 9 bundled server templates: `ai-community`, `blockchain-enterprise-community`, `clow-ecosystem`, `clow-studio-launch`, `content-creator`, `dev-community`, `gaming-community`, `startup-team`, `study-group`.
- Dry-run safety: templates and the architect agent are create-only — they never delete or overwrite.
- Local-machine trust: bot token stored at `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/credentials.json`, never leaves the machine.

## Commands at a glance

- `/discord:setup` — one-shot wizard (token + guild) via chat
- `/discord` — the do-anything front door; takes free-form intent
- `discord_apply_template` — apply a named JSON template, idempotent (create-only)
- `discord_raw_request` — direct Discord REST escape hatch for anything not yet wrapped
